title: Independent sound and freshness edits
scope: A preview panel has two independent flags: sound is quiet or loud; data is cached or fresh. The four named states exhaust the model. No other side effects or external calls exist. Each operation is atomic.

operations.name: Make quiet
operations.rule: Turn sound to quiet, preserving data freshness. From quiet-cached remain quiet-cached. From quiet-fresh remain quiet-fresh. From loud-cached become quiet-cached. From loud-fresh become quiet-fresh. The operation is enabled in all four states.

operations.name: Make fresh
operations.rule: Set data to fresh, preserving sound. From quiet-cached become quiet-fresh. From quiet-fresh remain quiet-fresh. From loud-cached become loud-fresh. From loud-fresh remain loud-fresh. The operation is enabled in all four states.
